values.required_outcome: One provider-neutral Runtime workload contract with explicit AWS and GCP Terraform implementations for the exact issue #194 and #268 CloudFormation-template behaviors.
declared_scope: Exact denominator inventory for issue #194 and #268 CloudFormation template behaviors
